errors.signInRequired: Sign in with ChatGPT or your own API key before asking for help.
errors.codexMissing: ChatGPT needs Codex installed on this PC. After installing it, use Sign in with ChatGPT here. Or choose an API key or local model instead.
signin.setup: ChatGPT needs Codex installed on this PC. Once it is installed, sign in here in Lalime; a terminal login does not connect this app. API keys and local models are also available.
signin.apiError: Could not sign in with that API key. Check the key and try again.
errors.handsMissing: Computer control is off because Hands.exe was not found. On Windows, run npm run build (needs .NET 8), then restart Lalime.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
onboarding.welcome.title: Help with your computer
onboarding.welcome.body: Describe what you need in everyday words. Lalime can use menus, clean up files, and help fix problems.
onboarding.guardian.title: You review risky steps
onboarding.guardian.body: Before anything risky, Lalime asks in plain English. Dangerous commands are blocked. You can manually restore files from the Recycle Bin after Lalime sends them there.
onboarding.signin.title: Use your own ChatGPT or API key
onboarding.signin.body: Sign in with your own ChatGPT account or paste an OpenAI API key. Lalime never ships a shared account.
onboarding.writer.title: Clearer replies (optional)
onboarding.writer.body: You can add an Anthropic API key so replies use Jackson’s Deliberate writing style. Without it, Lalime still works and shows the usual Codex text.
settings.signInBlurb: Every person uses their own ChatGPT account or OpenAI API key. Lalime never ships a shared login.
settings.writerBlurb: An Anthropic API key lets Lalime rewrite replies in clearer everyday English. Codex still does the work. Without a key, nothing changes.
settings.writerSaved: Writing key saved on this PC. Only the last four characters are shown here.
settings.writerRemoved: Writing key removed. Replies will use the regular Codex text.
empty.title: What do you need help with?
empty.body: Ask in everyday words. Lalime shows its plan, asks before anything risky, and tells you what changed.
gate.title: Sign in to continue
gate.body: Lalime talks to Codex with your ChatGPT account or your own OpenAI API key. There is no shared demo bot.
chips.downloads: Sort my Downloads folder and clean up the mess
chips.forms: Help me fill a form or update a spreadsheet
chips.programs: Open a program, click the buttons, and type for me
approval.hold: This is a more serious change. Take a second before confirming.
approval.skipNote: This step will not run. Lalime may continue with other steps.
approval.error: Your choice could not be sent. Try again.
approval.holdHint: Hold the button, Enter, or Space for 1.5 seconds. Release when ready to confirm.
approval.prepareHint: Prepare, wait two seconds, then choose Confirm this step. Nothing is approved automatically.
blocked.saferPrompt: Please suggest a safer way to achieve my last request. Explain the alternative before making changes, and keep all Guardian checks in place.
blocked.wait: You can ask for a safer approach when the current task finishes.
blocked.error: That request could not be sent. Try again.
stop.label: Stop
stop.title: Stop Lalime (Ctrl+Alt+Esc in the desktop app)
stop.error: The stop request could not be sent. Try Stop again.
stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.body: Lalime will not start another step until you send a message. Work already started may still finish; Stop does not undo earlier changes.
stopped.hint: Continue prepares a message for you to review and send. Start over clears your draft for a new request. Your history stays here.
stopped.prompt: Before continuing my last request, review what has already finished and explain the remaining steps. Keep all Guardian checks in place.
timeline.title: Steps for this turn
reply.speechUnavailable: Read aloud is unavailable on this device.
reply.speechError: Could not read this aloud. Try again.
reply.simplerPrompt: Please explain this answer in simpler words, one step at a time:
reply.sendError: Could not send that message. Try again.
followups.label: Keep going
followups.check: How can I check the result?
followups.activityPrompt: Please explain this activity in plain language:
approval.title.recycle: Move these items to the Recycle Bin?
approval.title.ui_click: Click a control on your computer?
approval.queueUnknown: Reviewing one step at a time. More steps may need your approval.
about.title: About Lalime
about.author: Made by Jackson Price. Open source
approval.allowScope: Lalime can repeat this exact step without asking until this task ends.
approval.holdUnavailable: This connection cannot prepare confirmation. Try again or choose Not now.
changes.title: What Lalime did this turn

changes.unverified: The restore was not verified. Try again.
changes.noUndo: Undo is not available for this entry.
changes.wait: Finish or stop the current task before undoing changes.
grants.title: Allowed for this task
grants.scope: Only the exact actions shown are allowed during this task. Stop or a new task clears these allowances.
grants.error: Could not revoke this allowance. Try again.
grants.unavailable: Revoking is unavailable in this session.
approval.holdBulk: This moves {count} items. Press and hold to confirm.
approval.holdAfterBlock: Lalime blocked something risky earlier in this task, so the next changes need a press-and-hold.
approval.queueReview: Reviewing one step at a time
approval.queuePreview: You will review each step and its exact details before deciding.
approval.allowCommandScope: Lalime can run this exact command again without asking until this task ends.
approval.allowFileScope: Lalime can repeat this exact action on these same items without asking until this task ends.
approval.manageGrants: Open Plan and activity to review or revoke allowances.
approval.queueViewOnly: Preview only. Decide on each step when it becomes current.
approval.grantUnavailable: Lalime will ask each time for this one.
composer.recall: Up arrow to edit your last request
approval.truncated: Preview shortened. Full text is available below.
approval.queueKeys: Use Up and Down to review, Home and End to jump, and Escape to close this preview.
approval.approveOnce: You can still approve it once.

changes.waitApproval: Answer the waiting approval first, then you can undo.
